messages:
Ana: hey team — drafting a compact partner compatibility playbook for SDK/API changes. goal: clear lanes, timelines, canary/runbook behavior, and partner comms. proposing three lanes: SAFE, COMPAT, BREAKING. also proposing standard notice windows: safe=0, compat=2 weeks, breaking=6 weeks (technical) + extra comms lead time if joint announcement needed. thoughts?
Mike: agree on lanes. suggest mapping to rollout behavior: SAFE -> auto rollout; COMPAT -> opt-in canary; BREAKING -> partner opt-in + gated rollout. also need traffic % schedule and automatic rollback thresholds.
Jess: from eng: must have a shim strategy for SI and hardware partners. propose a separate shim repo that can be patched and released independently of core SDKs.
Raj: SDK team: yes to shim repo. also want to normalize compatibility signals: single header like `Accept-Compatibility` or `x-rw-compat` so clients can opt in. would prefer `Accept-Compatibility: 2026-compat-v2`. server will interpret to select legacy/compat behavior.
Olivia: partners care about marketplace and co-announcement windows. ask for an 8-week minimum for joint announcements and 2-week marketplace freeze before public announce when billing/contract changes are involved. please bake these into the playbook.
Ana: updated timeline proposal: BREAKING = 6w tech notice + 8w comms window if co-announce + 2w marketplace freeze before announce; COMPAT = 2w notice + 1w canary; SAFE = immediate.
Mike: rollout policy suggestion: traffic progression 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h at each step. abort/rollback on >=1.5x error rate or >20% increase in latency P95. add automated checks and a human approval gate before 100%.
Jess: add a dark-run stage for hardware/SI partners: mirror production traffic to partner sandbox for 7 days before canary to surface infra-specific regressions.
Raj: SDK deliverables: publish compat-matrix.json, provide migration helpers (node/python scripts), and include sample curl with compatibility header. commit timeline: 2 weeks.
Olivia: comms plan: partner notice email -> partner-only webinar -> sandbox access -> public docs -> marketplace listing. timeline example for BREAKING: week0 notice, week3 webinar, week4-6 sandbox testing, week7 marketplace freeze, week8 public announce.
Mike: security note: private deployments require partner signoff via partners-sig@redwood and include KMS/HSM compatibility checklist.
Jess: QA checklist: unit tests, contract tests against compat-matrix.json, canary smoke tests, integration tests with shim and hardware partner images, post-rollout evals for quality regressions.
Ana: decision items: (1) approve lanes + timelines, (2) Raj publishes matrix + migrate scripts in 2 weeks, (3) DevEx to provision sandbox + scoreboard, (4) create partner escalation alias and comms templates. I'll open the playbook PR by EOD Friday unless objections.
Raj: SDK team ack; 2-week delivery noted.
Olivia: partnerships ack; I'll draft comms templates and webinar invite.
Mike: ops ack; I'll draft rollout automation and canary thresholds in the runbook.
Jess: eng ack; I'll add QA checklist to PR.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: partner-compat-playbook -> staging at 2026-05-12T09:00:00Z (preview: https://ci.redwood.dev/preview/partner-compat-playbook).
Ana: who owns monitoring alerts for partner scorecards?
Olivia: partnerships will own outreach and partner-facing alerting (oncall rotation TBD).
Mike: ops will own infra-level alerts (latency/error gates). we'll coordinate alert channels and escalation windows.
Ana: locking plan unless blockers raised before EOD Friday. :lock:
